title: How to choose colours — Image Wiki

rules.rule: If a palette fails to cohere, check if the job was defined as separation rather than cohesion before assuming hue is wrong.
rules.evidence: A palette that separates beautifully will often fail to cohere, so name the job first.

rules.rule: If a palette feels harmonious, ask whether it could plausibly come from a single real light source rather than assuming a named scheme.
rules.evidence: Ask whether this palette could come from a real light. If not, that is a style choice — say so rather than calling it wrong.
